ambient_events: Somebody stops on the kerb to retie a shoe.
A street sweeper goes by on Sorrel Way with its brushes up.
A sparrow lands on the kerb, finds nothing and goes.
description: A flowerbed off Sorrel Way, between the Winter Garden and 1 Kerbstone Row. The plain chrome hoarding of 8 Kerbstone Row closes the north end.
name: Sorrel Gardens
